home.heroSub: Luxury eco villas in the mountains above Sámara Beach.
home.introBody: Hacienda Chinampas was born from a vision to share this extraordinary place with travelers seeking something beyond the ordinary — a genuine connection with nature, local culture, and sustainable living.
home.groundsTitle: Where the land, the village, and the guest are one
home.groundsVillageBody: Fifteen minutes above Sámara Beach. Churches, founders, elders. Every villa on the property will be named after someone from the Chinampas community — a way of saying whose land this is.
home.groundsChinampasTitle: A floating-garden system, older than the village
home.groundsChinampasBody: Chinampas is also the pre-Columbian plot system of central Mexico, now a Globally Important Agricultural Heritage System. Coffee, papaya, mango, banana, rambutan, and star fruit cover the slopes.
home.groundsTableTitle: Grown on the mountain. Served at the house.
home.groundsTableBody: Blue Mountain Farms supplies the villas with Blue Zone organic produce, fresh poultry and meat, and coffee. There are five recognized Blue Zones in the world. The Nicoya Peninsula is one of them.
home.groundsTravelerBody: A traveler is someone in shared harmony with the land, the community, and the people who live there. Hacienda Chinampas is built for that stay — not the tourist passing through.
home.experiencesNote: Mountains meet the coast on the property — coffee, trails, farm kitchen, and Blue Zone rhythm. Everything below happens on the hillside.

specifics.title: Five private villas on twenty acres — organic produce, coffee, farm-to-table kitchen, fifteen minutes from Sámara Beach.

farm.title: A working farm, not a backdrop
farm.body: Sustainability is central to our ethos. We cultivate fruits, vegetables, and coffee using eco-friendly methods on-site. Guests enjoy fresh organic produce during their stay — and can take it home through Blue Mountain Farms.

coffee.title: From slope to cup
coffee.body: Walk the plantation, learn the delicate process of Costa Rican coffee-making, and cup the roast grown on these slopes.

people.title: Hospitality with proper nouns
people.body: Josué and the team keep every villa pristine and every trail open — world-class care on a working mountain farm.

footer.tagline: Luxury eco-tourism in the Blue Zone

accommodation.whatToPackValue: Light layers, reef-safe sunscreen, walking shoes, appetite for coffee
